packageRules.description: The pg majors in pgrx-base-images.toml are the support matrix, not staleness: each key deliberately maps to its own major (building 14 against 18 is not an update, it is a different matrix). Only digest and suffix refreshes within each major flow; new majors enter by adding a key, a reviewed change.

typescript-go tags its releases `typescript/vX.Y.Z`, and the belt pin carries the bare version because mise strips the prefix itself (version_prefix). Renovate compares the pin against raw tag names, so without this it can match nothing and the pin silently never moves — the failure mode a pinned tool exists to avoid.

rumdl tags its releases `vX.Y.Z` and the belt pin is bare. Without this, Renovate writes the raw tag into the pin (`rumdl = "v0.2.53"`, PR #470). The mise.lock refresh is Renovate running `mise lock` in its own container — measured on #567, where the belt's ORG_BELT_DIR template crashed it (#569); a bump that arrives lockless fails MISE_LOCKED on a version the lock has never heard of.

customManagers.description: pgrx base images: keep tag AND digest current together in docker/pgrx-base-images.toml — a pinned-but-stale base is worse than a floating one
